cues.en: whole entire course is the most important concept in machine learning, the train validation and test splits or commonly referred to as three sets.
cues.zh: 最重要的主題：訓練、驗證與測試切分，通常稱為三個資料集。

cues.en: Now, since you want to be using machine learning models to gain insights on some data to predict the future, it's important to test how well they would go and do in the real world.
cues.zh: 既然要用模型從資料取得洞見，預測未來，就要測試在真實世界的效果。

cues.en: To do this, you split your data into three different sets a training set to train your model on a validation
cues.zh: 把資料分成三組：訓練集用來訓練，驗證，

cues.en: set to churn your model on and a test set to test and compare your different models.
cues.zh: 集用來調整模型，測試集用來測試並比較不同模型。

cues.en: Why is this important?
cues.zh: 這為什麼重要？

cues.en: Think of it like this.
cues.zh: 想成這樣。

cues.en: When you're at university, you might study the course materials all through the semester.
cues.zh: 大學時，整學期閱讀課程教材。

cues.en: Then before the final exam, you might see how you can improve your knowledge on a practice exam.
cues.zh: 期末考前，透過模擬考，看看哪些知識還能改善。

cues.en: After doing well on the practice exam, you're confident you'll do well on the final exam.
cues.zh: 模擬考表現好，就有信心應付期末考。

cues.en: When you take the final exam and all those, some of the problems you've never seen before, you're able to adapt the knowledge you've learned from the study materials to the slightly different but similar
cues.zh: 期末考有些題目沒看過，但能把教材學到的知識，應用到稍有不同卻相似，

cues.en: questions on the final exam.
cues.zh: 的題目。

cues.en: Because of this, you pass the final exam with great marks.
cues.zh: 因此考出好成績。

cues.en: This adaptation that you had from the course materials and practice exams to the final exam is referred
cues.zh: 把教材與模擬考所學，應用到期末考的這種能力，

cues.en: to in machine learning as generalization or the ability for a machine learning model to perform well
cues.zh: 在機器學習叫泛化，也就是模型根據另一組資料，

cues.en: on data it hasn't seen before because of what it's learned on another data set.
cues.zh: 學到的內容，在未見資料上仍有良好表現。

cues.zh: 可能哪裡出錯？

cues.en: Well, if your professor accidentally sent out the final exam for everyone to practice on when it came time to the actual exam, everyone would have already seen it.
cues.zh: 如果教授不小心把期末試卷發給大家練習，正式考試時，所有人早就看過。

cues.en: Now, since people know what they should be expecting, they go through the exam and they answer all the questions with ease and everyone ends up getting top marks.
cues.zh: 大家知道題目，輕鬆作答，最後都拿高分。

cues.en: Now, top marks might appear good, but did the students really learn anything or were they just expert memorization machines?
cues.zh: 高分看起來很好，但真的學到東西，還是只是很會背答案？

cues.en: For your machine learning models to be valuable at predicting something in the future.
cues.zh: 要讓模型有價值，能預測未來，

cues.en: On unseen data, you'll want to avoid them becoming memorization machines.
cues.zh: 未見資料，就要避免變成死記的機器。

cues.en: This is where training, validation and test splits come in.
cues.zh: 這就是訓練、驗證與測試切分的用處。

cues.en: In our heart disease example, let's say there were 100 patients.
cues.zh: 心臟病例子裡，假設有 100 位患者。

cues.en: We start off with 100.
cues.zh: 一開始是 100 位。

cues.en: One way to create these splits is to shuffle these patients, then select 70% for training.
cues.zh: 一種切分方法，是先打亂，再選 70% 訓練。

cues.en: Which would mean that it would be about 70 patient records there and 15% for validation and 15% for testing, which means there'd be 70 patients in the training set.
cues.zh: 也就是約 70 筆病歷，15% 驗證，15% 測試；訓練集有 70 位。

cues.en: 15 patients in the validation split and 15 patients in the test split.
cues.zh: 驗證集 15 位，測試集 15 位。

cues.en: Now, the percentages of each of these may vary, but standard practice is usually around 70 to 80% for training, 10 to 15 for validation and 10 to 15 for test.
cues.zh: 比例會變，但常見做法大約是 70% 到 80% 訓練、10% 到 15% 驗證、10% 到 15% 測試。

cues.en: You may see in some examples that some sets or some data sets only get split into training and test, but that's a case by case scenario.
cues.zh: 有些例子只分訓練和測試，要視情況而定。

cues.en: Usually you'll have three different sets.
cues.zh: 通常會有三個不同資料集。

cues.en: Then once you've got these splits using a model you've chosen, you'd feed at the training data or the information of of these 70 patient records.
cues.zh: 切分後，使用選定模型，輸入訓練資料，也就是這 70 位患者資訊。

cues.en: And once your model had trained, you can check its results and see if you can improve them on the validation set.
cues.zh: 模型訓練完，再查看驗證集結果，看看能不能改善。

cues.en: This is where you'll do model tuning.
cues.zh: 這裡做模型調整。

cues.en: So just because you're machine learning models got one set of results on the patient records, you can actually improve them.
cues.zh: 即使模型在患者紀錄得到一組結果，仍然能改善。

cues.en: And we'll see this in a future lesson on the validation split.
cues.zh: 之後的課會在驗證集看到這點。

cues.en: Well, the validation split is where you should be testing to see if you can improve it.
cues.zh: 驗證集就是用來檢查能否改善的地方。

cues.en: And finally, once you've improved your model, you can check the model's results as well as any other model's results that you might have done during experimentation on the test set.
cues.zh: 最後改善模型後，再用測試集檢查結果，也比較實驗中建立的其他模型。

cues.en: What's important to remember is that all three of these sets are separate.
cues.zh: 重要的是，這三個資料集彼此獨立。

cues.en: During training, the model never sees the validation split or the test split.
cues.zh: 訓練時，模型不會看到驗證集或測試集。

cues.en: And during testing you're doing it on the test split, not the training set.
cues.zh: 測試時使用測試集，不是訓練集。

cues.en: It's the same as when you were studying for your exam.
cues.zh: 就像準備考試。

cues.en: If you saw the final exam whilst practicing, that would be cheating and your final result wouldn't reflect how well you'd learn.
cues.zh: 練習時看過期末試卷，就算作弊，最後成績不能反映真正學到多少。

cues.zh: 現在，
